translation_notes: M/R acknowledge this is arbitrary; literally "living out" one's life; has legalistic connotations
The resultant movement; publicly concealed as "ascending."
Negative mode of serviceability
Latin; the traditional definition of truth traced through Aquinas/Avicenna.

definition_in_bt: Truth as unconcealment/un-hiddenness; the pre-philosophical Greek understanding of truth.
translation_notes: M/R mostly use "truth"; the unconcealment sense (un-hiddenness) is not directly captured.; Heidegger's translation of Greek *alētheia*.; Greek; Heidegger reads it as privative *a-lētheia* (un-hiddenness).

definition_in_bt: The average, indifferent mode in which Dasein proximally and for the most part exists.
translation_notes: *durchschnittliche Alltäglichkeit* = average everydayness; The "how" of average existence; not the sum of days
The "something as something" structure constitutive of interpretation

definition_in_bt: The fundamental state-of-mind disclosing Being-in-the-world as a whole; individualizes Dasein.
translation_notes: M/R fn. (H.184): "generally translated as 'anxiety' in the post-Freudian psychological literature"; 'dread' in Kierkegaard translations; 'uneasiness' or 'malaise' might be more appropriate.; The state-of-mind disclosing Being-towards-death; sustained in anticipation
Etymologically connected to *Ruf*; M/R translate as "appeal"
Traditional philosophical anthropology; target of Heidegger's demarcation.

definition_in_bt: The traditional determination of Being as ousia/parousia; a specific mode of time (the 'present').
translation_notes: Key for the thesis that Being = presence. M/R's "presence" is standard but the etymological connection to *An-wesen* (coming-to-presence) is lost.
Specific kind of referring proper to signs
Greek term used directly; Greek: letting-be-seen; the primordial meaning of logos as assertion
Breakdown mode: missing equipment
Third characteristic of curiosity; indicates the restless rootlessness of fallen seeing.
Breakdown mode: damaged/unusable equipment
M/R translate as "summoning"; etymologically connected to *Ruf*
Breakdown mode: obstructive equipment
First signification of assertion; apophantic function

definition_in_bt: The authentic Present: resolute rapture in the Situation; distinguished from mere making-present.
translation_notes: Literally "glance of the eye." M/R translate as "moment of vision"; Stambaugh uses "Moment" or "instant." The term carries Kierkegaardian resonance (*Oieblikket*).; Literally "glance of the eye"; M/R's "moment of vision" is standard but debated — Stambaugh uses "Moment," Blattner prefers "instant." The term alludes to Kierkegaard's *Øieblikket*.; Already established in earlier sections; contested because the German literally means "glance of the eye" and carries connotations of Kierkegaard's *Oieblikket*

definition_in_bt: The working-out of understanding's projections; has the 'as'-structure.
translation_notes: Central term of §32; the working-out of understanding's projections

M/R note: *ausrichten* has many specialized meanings ("align," "explore," "make arrangements"). Heidegger keeps the root *Richtung* ("direction") in mind. M/R translate as "directionality" but also use "directedness."

definition_in_bt: A derivative mode of interpretation; the hermeneutical 'as' levelled to the apophantical 'as.'
translation_notes: Also translatable as "statement" or "proposition"; M/R prefer "assertion" to preserve the connection to *Aufzeigung* (pointing-out); The traditional "locus" of truth; shown to be derivative.
M/R note the financial metaphor (debt, bank deposit)
Falling Being-towards-death as fleeing

definition_in_bt: The relational totality of signifying; the formal existential structure of worldhood.
translation_notes: M/R footnote distinguishes "signify" (*be-deuten*) from "signification" (*Bedeutung*); Heidegger hyphenates *Be-deuten* to bring out the intensive prefix.; The "for-which" character of time; connected to worldhood
What gets Articulated as such in discursive Articulation
A termination of Dasein becomes 'Objectively' accessible in death of Others

definition_in_bt: The existentiale corresponding to mood; discloses Dasein in its thrownness.
translation_notes: M/R's "state-of-mind" is widely contested; Stambaugh uses "attunement," others "disposedness" or "affectedness." M/R note (H.134 fn.) it is close to "how one is, how one is faring"; Stambaugh uses "attunement"; Kisiel suggests "disposedness." M/R's "state-of-mind" is widely regarded as misleading.
Technical term for question-structure
The inauthentic mode of the having-been ecstasis
Second moment; not quietude but driven "hustle."; The "they's" covering-up of Being-towards-death

definition_in_bt: Dasein's practical engaged dealing with entities within the world; ontological term for concern.
translation_notes: M/R "concern"; the German covers "taking care of," "providing for," "attending to." Lost in English is the etymological connection to *Sorge* (care). See M/R fn. on H.57.; M/R discuss several options; "concern" chosen as least misleading. Stambaugh retains "concern."; Dasein's practical engagement with entities; grounded in care.; Practical engagement with the ready-to-hand
Ontic sense explicitly distinguished from *Sorge*.
Second signification of assertion
The uninhibited activity that tranquillizing drives Dasein into.
State-of-mind's openness to being affected by the encountered
Death impends; distinguished from impendence of environmental events
The phenomenal character of the "agreement" in truth: what gets confirmed is the entity's showing itself.

definition_in_bt: The character of 'having been assigned or referred'; the Being of the ready-to-hand.
translation_notes: M/R extensive footnote (H.84 fn.2): among the most difficult terms; "turning," "tendency," "course." Rendered via "involve" and "involvement" as closest.; The "in-order-to" structure of equipment
*A priori* perfect: Dasein has always already freed entities for involvement
Technical term for Dasein's self-testimony regarding authentic possibility
Idle talk's progressive loss of ground.
Standing under the dominion of Others/the "they"
Augustine's Latin; adopted by Heidegger to characterize the existential priority of seeing.
The Latin term from the Hyginus fable; double meaning: anxious exertion + devotedness.
The "there" of Dasein; marks essential disclosedness
The proper ontological characterization of Dasein that no longer exists (as opposed to merely "past")

definition_in_bt: The anonymous 'who' of everyday Dasein; an existentiale constituting publicness.
translation_notes: M/R note on H.149 (chapter heading): the German *man* has no single English equivalent; M/R use "the 'they'" with caution. Stambaugh uses "the Anyone."
A positive possibility of Dasein; not mere privation.

definition_in_bt: The entity that in each case we ourselves are; distinguished by its pre-ontological understanding of Being.
translation_notes: Left untranslated by M/R
The relational "now that..." structure

definition_in_bt: Positive retrieval: tracing hardened ontological concepts back to their primordial experiential sources.
translation_notes: M/R's "destruction" carries negative connotations that Heidegger explicitly disavows; "de-structuring" or "dismantling" proposed by others.
A way in which the "towards-which" of equipment becomes concrete
The Being of Things; Heidegger argues it cannot be "rounded out" with values
Modification of care: crowds out other possibilities.
Self-knowledge grounded in understanding
Death as Dasein's most proper and extreme possibility

definition_in_bt: A mode of Being in which Dasein seizes upon its own possibilities; grounded in mineness.
translation_notes: *Eigen* = own; "authenticity" imports connotations (sincerity, genuineness) absent from the German. Stambaugh retains "authenticity." Widely debated.; The modality of existence to be ontologically grounded
The process that strips datability and significance from the "nows"
Rejected as the primary mode of access to Others
Also "giving space"; M/R note metaphorical senses ("yielding," "granting")
Taking over the Other's care
Greek *ekstasis* = "standing outside." Heidegger: temporality is the primordial "outside-of-itself."
Distinguished into multiple senses: stopping, finishing, disappearing
Primordial temporality is finite; the authentic future closes one's potentiality-for-Being.

The hyphen marks the privative prefix *Ent-*: making-vanish of *Ferne* (farness). M/R's "de-severance" is standard but contested; Stambaugh uses "de-distancing." The term is both active and transitive.; Bringing-close; M/R hyphenate to preserve Heidegger's etymological play (*Ent-* = removal of *Ferne* = distance)
Heidegger's redefinition of Being-true. M/R use asterisk notation for hyphenated compound.
Character of Being of entities within-the-world (without Dasein's mode of Being); The Being-uncovered of entities; the ontic counterpart of *Erschlossenheit*.

Standard philosophical term, but Heidegger's usage is existential-ontological, not Marxian or Hegelian. Whether the resonance with those traditions is intentional is debated.; The "they" alienates Dasein from its ownmost potentiality-for-Being
The "they" disburdens Dasein of its Being
The "carrying-away" character of each ecstasis

definition_in_bt: Reticent, anxiety-ready self-projection upon one's ownmost Being-guilty; authentic disclosedness.
translation_notes: M/R note the etymological connection to *Erschlossenheit* (disclosedness) via the prefix *ent-*. Stambaugh translates as "resoluteness"; some scholars argue "disclosive resolve" better captures the *Erschlossenheit* connection.; Presupposed from §§60–62; the authentic disclosedness of Dasein
Modification: threatening is unfamiliar AND sudden

definition_in_bt: The existential structure of understanding: Dasein has always already projected itself upon possibilities.
translation_notes: M/R "projection"; root meaning is "throwing off/away." Stambaugh also uses "projection." The German connotations of designing/sketching are noted by M/R (H.145 fn.)
What resoluteness takes over in thrownness

mr_translation: that which is to be found out
translation_notes: Technical term for question-structure
Used as the general term for theoretical knowledge of the world.
Distinguished from phenomenon and semblance

definition_in_bt: The 'there' of Dasein; the clearing in which entities can be encountered.
translation_notes: M/R's "disclosedness" is standard; some prefer "disclosivity" or "openedness." Central term: Dasein *is* its disclosedness; M/R's "disclosedness"; Stambaugh uses "disclosedness" too, but some prefer "openedness." Key existentiale.; Resoluteness is authentic disclosedness
Modification of fear: the threatening breaks in suddenly

definition_in_bt: Stretchedness; the way temporality is ecstatically stretched along.
translation_notes: Related to the *Erstreckung* of historicality (§72); M/R vary between "stretching-along" and "stretched." Contested because the spatial connotation may mislead.
Technical term for how Dasein stretches between birth and death
Contrasted with *Vorlaufen*: expecting leaps to the actual

definition_in_bt: Dasein's manner of Being: a 'to-be' rather than a fixed substance with properties.
translation_notes: Heidegger's specific sense: Dasein's manner of Being; Heidegger's technical sense: Dasein's manner of Being, not traditional *existentia*
Contrasted with *Kategorien*; coined by Heidegger for this purpose.
One of the three fundamental characteristics of Dasein disclosed in anxiety.

definition_in_bt: The factuality of Dasein's being delivered over; not the factum brutum of something present-at-hand.
translation_notes: Ontologically distinct from factual occurrence (*Tatsaechlichkeit*).; Distinguished from *Tatsächlichkeit* (factuality) of the present-at-hand; One of the three fundamental characteristics; Dasein's thrownness.
The "I" as a non-committal formal indicator
The summary characterization of anticipation

definition_in_bt: Dasein's Being toward Others; ranges from leaping-in (domination) to leaping-ahead (liberation).
translation_notes: M/R note: no good English equivalent; "solicitude" chosen over "personal care" or "welfare work." The etymological connection to *Sorge* (care) and *Besorgen* (concern) is lost in English.; Dasein's comportment toward other Dasein; grounded in care.
The projected science of Being as such; §83 asks whether the analytic of Dasein can serve as its foundation
Concrete mode of *Befindlichkeit*; Distinguished from *Angst* throughout §40.
Existential possibility, not an ontic disposition
The totality of the structural whole sought in §39.; The structural whole; what must be grasped for primordial Interpretation
Dasein's potentiality for existing as a whole
Technical term for question-structure

Inauthentic Present; hyphened by M/R to flag its phenomenological sense

definition_in_bt: The ecstasis of making present; its authentic mode is the moment of vision (Augenblick).
translation_notes: Distinguished from ordinary "present" (*Jetzt*). The authentic mode is the *Augenblick*.; The ecstasis of making-present (distinct from *Anwesenheit*)

definition_in_bt: Everyday fallen discourse; groundless passing-along that closes off genuine disclosedness.
translation_notes: Previewed here; developed in §35 as fallen discourse; M/R note that "Gerede" in older editions carried quotation marks suggesting disparagement; Heidegger insists on a non-pejorative sense. Stambaugh uses "idle talk" as well, but the term remains debated.

definition_in_bt: The specific movement in which Dasein stretches itself along between birth and death.
translation_notes: M/R translate as "historizing" to preserve the verbal/processual character; other translators use "happening" or "occurrence"
M/R note the four-fold ordinary signification; Stambaugh sometimes uses "story" for emphasis; contested because the German carries the verbal sense of *Geschehen* (happening) which "history" loses

definition_in_bt: Dasein's constitutive character of being-historical; grounded in temporality.
translation_notes: M/R's rendering is standard but alternatives include "historicity."; Previewed: the temporalization-structure of temporality that reveals Dasein as "historical."; Central term of the chapter; existentiale grounding "history"

definition_in_bt: The communal historizing of a people; co-historizing in Being-with Others.
translation_notes: M/R translate as "destiny" and note the etymological connection with *Geschichte*; communal counterpart to *Schicksal*. The M/R footnote (p.436) explains the distinction at length
Written mode of idle talk.

definition_in_bt: The stretched character of the 'during'; time's spannedness grounded in ecstatic temporality.
translation_notes: M/R's "spannedness" is awkward; Stambaugh uses "tension." Heidegger connects it to *Erstrecktheit* (stretching-along). The term captures the "during" structure of time.

definition_in_bt: The ecstasis of authentically taking over thrownness; not 'pastness' but the existential 'back-to.'

The authentic understanding of the appeal
Existential certainty grounded in Being-in-the-truth; not empirical

translation_notes: Distinguished from mere spatial position (*Stelle*)
Heidegger's gloss on Greek usage; things of *praxis*

Central term across §§22–24; Dasein's existential character; grounded in temporality
Truth as uncoveredness must be wrested from entities — a striking metaphor.

definition_in_bt: The Being of entities present-at-hand within-the-world; no priority among modes of Being.

M/R note etymological connection of Anruf/Aufruf/Ruf (fn. 1, p.314)
Privative modification of phenomenon

definition_in_bt: That which is to be found out (das Erfragtes) through the question of Being.

definition_in_bt: The Being of Dasein: ahead-of-itself-Being-already-in-(the-world-)as Being-alongside.

Distinguished from *Rede*: language is discourse expressed in words

Equivocal: sometimes substantiality, sometimes the entity itself
The character of Being belonging to substance; Descartes leaves unclarified

definition_in_bt: The possibility of the absolute impossibility of Dasein; ownmost, non-relational, certain, indefinite.

"Being is the *transcendens* pure and simple"; The world's being-disclosed; grounded in ecstatico-horizonal temporality

definition_in_bt: That which transmits interpretations of Being but also conceals their primordial sources.

M/R note: *Um-* = "around"; not primarily spatial

The "when" of death is indeterminate
M/R note: literally "devoid of relationships"; some translators prefer "unrelational"

definition_in_bt: A mode of Being in which Dasein has not yet won itself; a positive existential determination.

definition_in_bt: Not-being-at-home; the more primordial phenomenon from which everyday familiarity flees.

translation_notes: M/R cross-reference to H.322; rewritten as *Un-selbständigkeit*

Contrasted with *Unverborgenheit*.
Effect of anxiety: singularizing Dasein.

definition_in_bt: Dasein's absorption in the publicness of the 'they'; a positive existential structure, not moral judgment.
